name: AvatarRoot
description: Combines `Avatar.ImagePrimitive` and `Avatar.FallbackPrimitive` into a single part that shows a user's profile image, falling back to the first letter of `alt` when the image is missing or fails to load. Pass the primitives as `children`, or use `imageElement` or `fallbackElement`, to replace the image or fallback. Renders a `<span>` element.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the avatar, controlling width, height, corner radius, and the typography of the fallback.

props.name: onLoadingStatusChange
props.description: Callback fired when the loading status changes.

props.name: className
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: fallbackElement
props.description: Replaces the default `Avatar.FallbackPrimitive`. Ignored when `children` are given.

props.name: imageElement
props.description: Replaces the default `Avatar.ImagePrimitive`. Ignored when `children` are given.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: delay
props.description: How long to wait before showing the fallback. Specified in milliseconds.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description:
Whether the image element stays mounted and loads in place instead of being preloaded.
Supports `loading="lazy"` and optimized image components such as `next/image`.

props.name: render
props.detailedType: ReactElement | ((props: HTMLProps, state: Avatar.Root.State) => ReactElement) | undefined
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
